column15: bit 0 = Heat pump switched on; bit 1 = Heat pump running; bit 2 = Alarm; bit 3 = DHW being heated; bit 4 = Heating circuit 1 circulation pump running; bit 5 = Heating circuit circulation pump running (printed as circuit 1 again); bit 6 = Solar circulation pump running; bit 7 = Swimming pool circulation pump running; bit 8 = Defrosting; bit 9 = Auxiliary heater operating; bit 10 = Summer operation; bit 12 = Cooling operation
0 = Automatic mode; 1 = Heat pump only; 2 = Not used; 3 = Auxiliary heating only; 4 = Off mode; 5 = Manual mode; 6 = Cooling mode
